query:
SELECT DISTINCT i.equipamentoTag as tagPlanilha, e.codigoTag as tagCadastro, e.nomeDoEquipamento
FROM item_despesa_importado i
INNER JOIN equipamentos e ON UPPER(REPLACE(i.equipamentoTag, ' ', '')) = UPPER(REPLACE(e.codigoTag, ' ', ''))
WHERE e.id IN (29, 20, 40, 38, 37, 86, 91, 50, 87)
AND i.periodoCustoId = 60001
LIMIT 20
